To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The HTWs in evaporating droplets and liquid layers give rise to travelling physical waves, (2) The latent energy required during phase change tends to inhibit the instabilities while the accompanying level reductions enhance the physical waves, (3) Phase change and the Marangoni effect play a major role in determining the dynamics of the vapour phase, (4) Three-dimensional phenomena are observed in evaporating drops placed on heated surfaces.
the Marangoni effect has a significant impact on vapour dynamics above the interface and the resulting phase change.
the dynamics of the vapour phase plays a crucial role in the stability and dynamics of the interface.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the stability and dynamics of thermocappillary flows and their interaction with the phase change.
the dynamics of the gas-liquid interface during evaporation of thin liquid layers and sessile droplets.
the stability and the two-phase dynamics of evaporating Marangoni- driven flows in laterally-heated liquid layers and sessile droplets.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dynamics of the gas and liquid phases are closely interwoven and the phase change is a major factor in the development of the instabilities in the liquid and vapour phases.
phase-change dynamics is a very complex phenomenon, and that the Marangoni effect, in particular, has a significant impact in this regard.
phase change is not only a passive phenomenon but it also plays an active role in the dynamics of thermally driven flows in the presence of a liquid-vapour interface.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
phase change and Marangoni effects are the key ingredients to understand the dynamics of evaporating liquid layers and sessile droplets.
we have been able to demonstrate the importance of phase change in the dynamics and the instabilities of the interface in the presence of Marangoni effects.
the Marangoni effect has a significant impact on evaporation, and the dynamics of the gas and liquid phase are strongly coupled.

the HTWs are not restricted to planar configurations and that the Marangoni effect can play a major role on the dynamics of evaporating droplets.
the Marangoni effect is a key factor in the dynamics of the vapour phase and in the stability of the liquid phase.
the Marangoni-driven flow is a key factor that controls the dynamics of evaporating droplets and should not be overlooked.
